name: persona
wording: a named agent over one role, chosen for the expertise a project needs, above all its contexts and their industry; overrides the role's single values, its objective included, extends its sets, may narrow but never widen reach, never removes a guardrail; the generic role serves where none fits
reason: A persona's override reaches its role's objective too: nico, over the architect, holds parsimony in place of conceptual integrity, so the architect's Brooks gloss is not nico's. The design already allowed it; it is stated so it is not read as a gap.
